review_question: Among randomized trials in people with COVID-19, what is the effect of ivermectin-containing treatment compared with placebo or standard care on all-cause mortality?

pico.population: People with COVID-19 enrolled in randomized controlled trials
pico.comparator: Placebo, standard care, or no additional experimental treatment
pico.outcome: All-cause mortality at the source-reported trial follow-up

outcome.description: All-cause mortality explicitly reported for a randomized arm at a source-defined follow-up

targets.comparison: Ivermectin-containing arm versus placebo, standard care, or no additional experimental treatment
targets.population_or_subgroup: Randomized trial population; preserve source-reported analysis population when the mortality table specifies it

timepoint_policy.rule: Use the mortality table's explicitly reported trial follow-up. Do not infer a death count from an adjacent composite outcome, absence of disease progression, or discussion text.

candidate_capture_policy.record_scope: Record every source-supported randomized arm with explicit mortality events and outcome denominators; preserve multi-arm studies without manual aggregation.

targets.quantitative_use_policy: Extract explicit deaths and the outcome-table denominator for each randomized arm. A report that does not explicitly provide arm-level death counts is not quantitative extraction gold for this target.
